gre_subject.value: The department no longer takes the GRE.
gre_subject.quote: We no longer take the GRE for graduate applicants.

supervisor.value: Most students enter unattached to a lab and choose one after three first-semester rotations; contacting faculty about rotations is encouraged.
supervisor.quote: Our entering students work in three different laboratories during the first semester (5 weeks in each laboratory). | Most students, however, enter our program unattached to any specific lab.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students get a TA or RA covering tuition and a $2,500 monthly stipend, for as long as they stay in good standing.
funding.quote: As long as the student remains in good standing with the department and the Office of Graduate and Professional Studies, they will be fully supported until the degree is completed. | Students do not have to apply for the assistantships; we provide support to all admitted Ph.D. students.

entry_route.value: The page does not state the degree needed to enter.

gre_general.value: The department no longer takes the GRE.

toefl_min.value: The department expects TOEFL above 100 with speaking 23+.
toefl_min.quote: In order for your application to be considered, you should have a TOEFL score of above 100 total, with a speaking score of 23 or higher.

ielts_min.value: The department expects IELTS above 7 with speaking 7+.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS scores should be above 7 total, with a speaking score of 7 or higher.

fee_waiver.value: A limited number of fee waivers; submit the form by November 1.
fee_waiver.quote: We offer a limited number of graduate application fee waivers. To be considered for a fee waiver please submit the form at this link by November 1st.
